clips.title: The story
paras: The Great Outdoors is an introductory wilderness survival lesson offered to hunters by an experienced scout named Lyreena. It emphasizes the importance of resting beside a campfire to recover and gain the Boosted Rest buff while journeying through the untamed wilds.

Venturing beyond civilization's borders demands more than sharp aim and keen senses; it requires respect for the raw untamed elements. An experienced scout named Lyreena offers guidance to wandering hunters, welcoming them to pause their trek and take comfort by her campfire. In the perilous wilds of Azeroth, knowing how to establish a hearth and replenish one's strength between hunts is just as critical as knowing how to track quarry.

A roaring campfire provides comfort against the nocturnal cold, offering a moment of calm where weary travellers can shake off fatigue. Sitting close to the blaze allows adventurers to gain Boosted Rest, revitalizing their energy and preparing them for the rigors of exploration. Taking time to sit by the embers teaches young adventurers that patience and rest are enduring pillars of wilderness survival.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, hunter. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.
You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
